title: addTask no longer reloads after the POST
summary: app/page.tsx addTask drops the load() call that used to follow the POST, so the client never refetches the task list and the new task never appears. The POST itself succeeds server-side, but the "creating a task..." test fails at toContainText on the task list.

expectedFailure.testTitle: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
